head_sway_norm.points_at: A miss that repeats at about the same size every swing. Whatever produces it is the same every time, which points at something already set before the swing starts rather than at something that happens during it. None of that is visible here, so the test is empirical: change one thing at setup, hit another set, and see whether the center moves.
